settings.heading: BUILT FOR GROWING FEET - AND BUSY FAMILIES

settings.text:
Most kids’ shoes are just small adult shoes. They restrict natural movement, with stiff soles that pinch toes and stop feet from moving freely.

Aretto is truly barefoot. Its flexible, zero-drop soles keep heels and toes level, letting feet move naturally. The wide toe box gives toes room to spread, and each pair expands to grow with developing feet. Every step feels natural, safe, and free—so kids can play, explore, and grow with confidence.

settings.title: Why an expanding shoe matters
settings.content:
1.Grows with their feet: Patented SuperGrooves expands across up to 3 sizes. The flexible sole allows natural movement, and the zero-drop design keeps the foot level.
2.⁠ ⁠Cushioned and breathable: SquishyFoam absorbs impact, and the stretchy Infiknit upper moves with the foot and stays breathable.
3.⁠ ⁠Secure fit: Midfoot panels hold the foot in place, the padded collar supports the heel, and a padded tongue sits under the straps.
4.⁠ ⁠Easy to adjust: Velcro straps let kids put the shoes on and adjust the fit themselves. The non-marking sole suits school corridors and indoor courts.

settings.title: Product description
settings.content:
1. Designed for Growing Feet- Patented Supergrooves™ sole expands up to 3 sizes (18mm), so one pair adapts to growing feet. - Wide toe box lets toes spread naturally, improving grip and preventing crowded toes. - Zero-drop design supports healthy posture and natural walking, just like barefoot.- Shaped for real kids’ proportions—not scaled-down adult shoes.

2. All-Day Comfort- SquishyFoam insoles cushion every step while keeping the barefoot feel kids need.- Infiknit™ knit upper Stretches with every move, no pinching during play.- Lightweight build keeps kids active without tiring their feet.- Breathable fabric keeps feet cool and dry even after long hours at school or play.

3. Practical for Everyday Life- Slip-on design with elastic flex makes mornings faster—kids can do it themselves.- Suitable for school, sports, and daily wear, so you don’t need separate pairs.- Comfortable enough for long classes, durable enough for playground scrambles.

4. Built to Last- Reinforced toe and heel protect against scuffs and rough play.- Durable sole grips well on different surfaces, indoors or outdoors.- Premium materials chosen to withstand daily use while staying comfortable.- Available in sizes EU 20–37 to support kids through growing years.
